verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable rule that automatically runs an action when an event occurs. The nearby features don't qualify. Infra Analytics alerts are notifications for regressions, not triggered actions. Scheduled Rollouts are time-based, not event-driven. Autotune reallocates traffic toward a winning variant without user-authored trigger rules. CLI integration into CI/CD pipelines is a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
